title: RhetorLint Analysis Result
description: The result of analyzing a passage for configured, visible rhetorical patterns. A mark combines an observed span and position with rule-pack-authored classification and review fields. Those interpretations are not findings about intent, recipient effect, deception, or factual truth.

density.description: A count of configured matches, raw and normalized by passage length. It is not a truth, effect, harm, intent, or quality score.

strip.description: Deterministic reduction-and-annotation counterfactual: lexical intensifiers removed and passives with omitted agents flagged with [who?]. Modality, attribution, and verb-phrase hedges stay intact. This is not guaranteed to preserve meaning or factual truth. On-device; no model required.

rewrite.description: OPTIONAL caller-supplied model rewrite. Null when only the deterministic core ran. The core does not verify its meaning, provenance, factual support, or truth.

ruleId.description: Legacy family.tell identifier for the configured rule, e.g. 'agency-hiding.deleted-subject'. Its name is not a contextual verdict.

displayName.description: Neutral rule-pack-authored display label. Legacy rule IDs may contain historical interpretive terms; consumers should prefer this field in prose.

family.description: Rule-pack-authored candidate taxonomy family: six SemEval-2023 parents plus RhetorLint's structural extension. A match does not establish that the family interpretation applies in context.

technique.description: Rule-pack-authored candidate technique/lineage label, aligned verbatim to SemEval-2023 where one maps. It is not a contextual classification finding.

classificationStatus.description: Machine-readable status for the ruleId/family/technique/note/expected classification fields. Current engines emit it; it is optional only so older 0.1 results remain schema-valid.

taxonomyMappingStatus.description: Relationship between the rule concept and its taxonomy technique label. Candidate values still require contextual evaluation and are not classification findings.

actual.description: The real, visible phrase that was marked. Every mark MUST point at text a reader can see.

note.description: A one-line description of the matched surface pattern. It must not assert speaker intent or a recipient effect.

expected.description: Candidate clarity prompt(s) for human or agent review. They are not verified replacements and may not preserve meaning.

confidence.description: Uncalibrated, author-assigned rule-match weight. Not a probability of intent, recipient effect, deception, or truth.

level.description: Rule-authored review/display band mapped to SARIF result.level. It is not a severity estimate for conduct, effect, deception, harm, or falsehood.
